pages.narration: Welcome to Tik Tots, a world full of creators, dreamers, and best friends!
But when Tiko can't stop scrolling, time starts to disappear.
Suddenly, a mysterious glowing door appears. Where could it lead?
Together, the Tik Tots step through, with Buddy right beside them.
They discover the Endless Scroll, where everyone has forgotten how to create.
This isn't fun, and it isn't real. The friends know they have to change it.
They use their talents: draw, sing, build, solve, explore, and imagine!
Together they create something amazing, and kindness and teamwork bring the world back to life.
The world is bright again, and the adventure never ends.
Friendship, creativity, and good vibes. That's what Tik Tots is all about.
There's always another door, and another adventure waiting for you.
Don't just scroll. Create, imagine, share, and smile.
